transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Last spring I ended up in Chengdu for a few days, mostly just wandering around and eating way too much spicy stuff.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And earlier that same year I was in Suzhou for work—honestly I remember the canals more than the meetings.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Oh, and that Beijing trip—my cousin dragged me through a bunch of classic attractions, the whole tourist checklist vibe.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: In Chengdu I actually ate at Chen Mapo Tofu once; I went on 2025-04-12 and it was a solo lunch thing.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I remember the reservation details were under Deng Hui, and the time was 12:00—someone had texted me the info so I wouldn’t mess it up.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For Suzhou, my colleague Chen Ming had us at Pan Pacific Suzhou—check-in was 2025-03-19 and we stayed 2 nights; I still laugh thinking how organized he was, even had his phone down as 13812345678 on the notes.
